title: JT
creator: CrossFit
description: 21-15-9 reps of handstand push-ups, ring dips and push-ups. Honours U.S. Navy SEAL Petty Officer 1st Class Jeff Taylor, killed near Asadabad, Afghanistan, in 2005; the first Hero WOD ever posted. All pressing, so the last push-ups are the hardest reps. Scale handstand push-ups to pike and ring dips to bench dips.
